newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Precision Drilling starts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Precision Drilling starts.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim said on Tuesday it had started coverage of Canadian oil drilling company Precision Drilling Corp PDa.TO with a rating of significant outperform.
-- In a report, analyst James Stone wrote the company was Canada's leading contract driller and a technological leader in the industry.

-- He said Precision Drilling had a growing well servicing business, was a strong gas compression fabricator, had profitable oilfield rentals and was likely to pursue an aggressive acquisition and consolidation strategy.
-- Stone forecast a growth in pro forma revenues in 1997 of more than 20 percent, to $420 million, and for gross margins to improve to 30.9 percent. Revenues are expected to rise 13 percent in 1998.
-- The company's American Depositary Receipts closed at 30-7/8 on Monday.
